_doc: Sea-trade EXPORT-flow corpus for cracking the per-lane sea law. Each row is a live in-game trade-scroll EXPORT value (the exporter's earning on that route). IMPORT rows are NOT stored — the import = export/5 law is confirmed exact (Kyrene exports 430 to Arsinoe -> Arsinoe imports 86 = 430/5; Arsinoe exports 140 -> Kyrene imports 28 = 140/5).

law_hypothesis.base: 1.10 * sqrt(popExporter + popImporter)  — confirmed: Kyrene<->Arsinoe popSum 8100 -> base ~99; Arsinoe->Kyrene honey-only 4 cargo -> 140 = 99 + ~41
law_hypothesis.cargo: Sum over traded goods of qty * tradeValue (already type-weighted: spices=3, salt=2, bulk=1). The honey-only control (value 1) fits the SAME slope as mixed cargo, proving type is captured by the value-weighting, not a separate term.
law_hypothesis.slope_open: slope depends on distance d (and possibly exporter size). Observed: d24 -> ~10.3, d32 -> ~6.2, d16 -> ~7. Non-monotonic on 6 cyrene points; needs cross-faction data to pin.
law_hypothesis.rights: cross-faction routes multiply by trade-deal rights (0.33 if no rights, else 1). Intra-faction (all cyrene rows below) = 1.

needed_to_crack: Same sea-route sweep on 1-2 more factions in different seas (Italy / Aegean / Egypt-Nile) with varied distances, good-types, and trade-deal states. Then one regression fits base + slope(d) and replaces ALL the seaLaneF pins (julii included).
